Manga 'Dokagui Daisuki! Mochizuki-san' Gets TV Anime Adaptation
Production company TOHO animation opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Kamome Maruyono’s Dokagui Daisuki! Mochizuki-san (I Love Dokagui! Mochizuki-san) manga on Tuesday, revealing a celebratory illustration by Maruyono. Animation studio Passione is producing the anime. Maruyono began serializing the comedy gourmet manga in Young Animal Zero magazine and Young Animal Web website in May 2024. 'Yasei no Last Boss ga Arawareta! 2nd Season' Reveals Additional Cast, Opening Theme, First Promo
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Firehead's Yasei no Last Boss ga Arawareta! (A Wild Last Boss Appeared!) light novel revealed additional cast, the opening theme, and first promotional video for the second season on Tuesday. The new season is scheduled to premiere on Tokyo MX, BS Asahi, and Kansai TV in October 2026. Manga 'Shin Tennis no Oujisama' Concludes 27-Year Serialization
Takeshi Konomi's Shin Tennis no Oujisama (The Prince of Tennis II) manga concluded in the September 2026 issue of Jump SQ. on Tuesday, marking the end of its nearly 27-year serialization. Konomi began serializing the sequel sports manga in Jump SQ. in March 2009. Shueisha published the 47th volume on June 4. The 48th and final volume is scheduled to be released on September 4.
